g.text: From a quiet year to Rising Star
You showed up 274 days in 3 years.
189 pull requests opened, 174 merged — 149 in someone else’s repo.
first public repo, 2024-09-24 — the floor this whole story climbs from.
★ is the high mark in that column.
2025 had the most own PRs. 2026 took the rest.

text.tspan: 1 repo created (seuthootDev), 1 still active a year later.
1 public repos. 1 lived past a year.
TypeScript was the main language. 14 repos created (dash_vtk_and_vtk.js, hanghae-nestjs-crud-study, and 12 more), 2 still active a year later.
22 of 24 pull requests merged, all in your own repos.
External PRs landed (Change9-ai/plc_ladder_to_st, Change9-ai/plcStudio, and 8 more) this year.
165 pull requests opened, 152 merged — 149 in someone else’s repo.
